part.text:
Yes, ripgrep's special ignore-file name used to be **`.rgignore`** in its early days, before being switched to support **`.ignore`** generically.

### Commit Details

* **Commit SHA:** `cc90511ab29d3c37e873acac0fd80f90473f54bb`
* **Author:** Andrew Gallant <jamslam@gmail.com>
* **Date:** Fri Sep 23 22:44:17 2016 -0400

### Commit Message Quote

> Switch from .rgignore to .ignore.
> 
> But don't actually remove support for .rgignore until the next semver
> bump.
> 
> Note that this puts us in line with the silver searcher:
> https://github.com/ggreer/the_silver_searcher/pull/974
> 
> Fixes #40

### Diff Quote (Supporting Change)

The ignore-file name array change in `src/ignore.rs` of that commit shows `.ignore` being added alongside the existing `.rgignore`:

```diff
diff --git a/src/ignore.rs b/src/ignore.rs
index d784f99..0195420 100644
--- a/src/ignore.rs
+++ b/src/ignore.rs
@@ -24,6 +24,7 @@ use types::Types;
 
 const IGNORE_NAMES: &'static [&'static str] = &[
     ".gitignore",
+    ".ignore",
     ".rgignore",
 ];
```
